modelingNotes: Vantage South End, 1100 S. Tryon St, South End, Charlotte: two 11-storey office towers either side of a landscaped courtyard on Carson Blvd (Vision Ventures / Childress Klein, completed 2021) — procedural, CC0-1.0. bun generators/clt-vantage-south-end.ts

The two towers are different designs, so one model draws both: - West Tower (Winnifred St side; LendingTree, signs on the crown): a long wedge of pale reflective glass, its glass box cantilevered over a colonnade of round columns at the Carson Blvd end (Sixty Vines below), on a charcoal-brick base; its south third, toward the parking deck, is a grey precast grid with punched windows. - East Tower (S. Tryon St side; The Hartford, Alston & Bird, Grant Thornton): the same height and glass, with the courtyard face broken by a stack of angled, recessed balconies (the "sawtooth" seen from Carson), on a one-storey charcoal-brick base. The plan reads as two mirrored wedges opening the courtyard toward Carson.

Evidence: - OSM: way/1059944465 (West Tower, height 51, 11 levels), way/1059944467 (East Tower, height 51, 11 levels). No building:parts. The parking deck way/875274994 (across Vantage Park Dr) is not drawn and not replaced. - USGS NAIP (public domain) for the plan, the white roofs, the mechanical screens on each roof and the stepped courtyard face of the East Tower. - Lidar, USGS 3DEP NC Phase 4 Mecklenburg 2016 (1 m): flown before the towers were built, so used for the ground only. Ground under the footprints rises ~1.4 m from the West Tower's Winnifred face (y = 0) to the East Tower. - Photos (Wikimedia Commons, City Dweller 2, CC BY-SA 4.0, May 2024): https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Vantage_South_End_viewed_from_the_Crown_of_the_Queen_City_Mid-May_2024.jpg (both towers from the north-east) https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Vantage_South_End_from_The_Roman_Catholic_Diocese_Pastoral_Center_Mid-May_2024.jpg (West Tower from the north-west) https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Vantage_South_End_along_Winnifred_Early_May_2024.jpg (West Tower, north corner, colonnade) https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Vantage_South_End_along_South_Church_St_Mid-May_2024.jpg (West Tower from the west) https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Vantage_South_End_Courtyard_on_West_Carson_Early_May_2024.jpg (courtyard: both towers' Carson ends, the sawtooth) https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Vantage_South_End_sculptures_Mid-May_2024.jpg (East Tower courtyard face, brick base) https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Vantage_South_End_along_West_Carson_Blvd_Mid-May_2024.jpg (West Tower cantilever and columns) https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Vantage_South_End_from_South_Tryon_St_near_West_Morehead_St_Mid-May_2024.jpg (East Tower from up Tryon)

Heights: roofs 51 m above each tower's own ground (OSM height; consistent with 11 storeys in the photos: a ~6 m ground floor, ~4.2 m offices, a parapet). Estimated from the photos: the West Tower's glass box starting at 10.5 m and its colonnade 9 m deep, the East Tower's brick base (6.5 m), the balcony notches (position and size), the mechanical screens (4 m tall, plan from NAIP), mullion spacing. The towers' published height was not found.
Doubts: no photo of the Tryon (south-east) face of the East Tower or of the Vantage Park Dr ends; they are drawn like the other glass faces. The crown signs are not modelled.
Model frame: bearing 41 (model +y runs north-east along Winnifred St and S. Tryon St; +x is south-east, toward Tryon); metres above the base. Anchor: area centroid of the two towers.
Exports the curtain-wall helpers used by clt-dfa-building and clt-110-east.

Original procedural model from https://github.com/alexwohlbruck/landmarks (catalog id "clt-vantage-south-end", model "clt-vantage-south-end"), generated by https://github.com/alexwohlbruck/landmarks/blob/a1974bbf738c6994edbe99a7a61818b9d69da9e0/generators/clt-vantage-south-end.ts. That repository is the editable source; source.blend.gz is the exported mesh imported into Blender for convenience.

Exported for Open Landmarks v1: placement bearing and scale baked in; moving parts frozen in their rest pose; footings and basements below the lowest ground (y = 0) cut away; material colours carried over exactly, as library finishes where they are not standard swatches.

Window panels clipped to the walls behind them; 287 m² of glazing with no wall behind it (curtain walls, glazing past a wall's edge) uses the clt-vantage-south-end-glazing finish in the window colour.
To fit six materials, folded clt-vantage-south-end-vantage-mullion into clt-vantage-south-end-vantage-roof (ΔE 3.2).
